text: using Seurat package downstream analysis, following code can used read matrix convert Seurat SCE objects: Optionally, “raw” matrix can also imported used background: Note decontaminated matrix decontX consists floating point numbers must rounded integers adding Seurat object. already Seurat object containing counts matrix like run decontX, can retrieve count matrix, create SCE object, run decontX, add back Seurat object:
